title: Yarn Berry (v2+)
description: Modern Yarn with Plug'n'Play, workspaces, and improved performance.

data.text: Yarn Berry (v2+) is a complete rewrite of Yarn with Plug'n'Play (PnP) by default, eliminating node_modules for faster installs and better security. It supports workspaces, constraints, and a plugin ecosystem.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Yarn Berry uses Plug'n'Play by default
data.takeaway: Yarn Berry represents the future of package management with PnP and zero-installs.
